text:
ana-marketing: Quick sync — Cohort Jetpack email cadence for next week's benchmark webinar + post-webinar product tour. Need copy owners, segment rules, and send windows.

leo-growth: I can own the webinar invite copy + subject lines. Who takes the product-tour follow-up?

mia-campaigns: I'll own the follow-up. Recommend we split follow-ups by engagement band (high / mid / low).

olivia-design: I'll do hero imagery + 2 preview GIFs. Need final copy by Tue 10am PT to hit Wed send.

dylan-sales: For handoff include calendar CTA and a direct demo CTA. Also want a lead tag so reps can filter.

campaign-bot: Suggested send windows:
- Invite: Wed 09:00 PT
- Reminder: Thu 11:00 PT
- Follow-up / product tour: Mon 09:00 PT

leo-growth: Segment rules (draft):
```
if user.has_recent_usage(30d) and user.token_volume > 10000 -> segment = "power"
elif user.has_recent_usage(30d) -> segment = "active"
else -> segment = "cold"
```
Also propose VIP seed: customers with contract_tier in ["enterprise", "platform"] and prior attended_webinar = true.

mia-campaigns: A/B subject tests (two variants each):
A1: "See Redwood's latency wins in our benchmark"
A2: "Low-latency LLM serving — benchmark highlights"
B1: "Join the live product tour after the webinar"
B2: "How we cut per-token cost — product tour"

olivia-design: Figma mock will be ready by Mon EOD: https://figma.com/file/placeholder (I'll paste final link)

ana-marketing: Owners confirmed: leo-growth = invite, mia-campaigns = follow-up, olivia-design = creative. Agreed segment dims: product_tag, 30d token volume, webinar_history.

dylan-sales: Sales tag: `lead:jetpack_webinar` — please add to leads created from RSVP and attended.

campaign-bot: Content freeze reminder set for Tue 10:00 PT. Campaign ID: CJ-2026-03-30.

leo-growth: I'll push final subjects + preheader by Mon morning.

mia-campaigns: I'll prepare 3 follow-up templates (power / active / cold).

olivia-design: Noted on assets timeline.

ana-marketing: Perfect — small checklist: copy owners, assets link, send windows, segment rules, sales tag, A/B specs. If no blockers, we go green. :rocket:

dylan-sales: :thumbsup: green from sales side.

ana-marketing: Thanks team — will update the campaign doc and add assignees.
